== The Complete Lojban Language ==
Note that the book [http://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-no-chunks/ The Complete Lojban Language] is still considered by quite a few new learners as the best tutorial although by design this wasn't meant to be any tutorial.

Namely, the order of chapters may seem to be arbitrary to those who wish to use this book to study Lojban. So one recommendation is ... to read various sections from the book randomly. If you don't understand something skip to another part.

If you still wish to try something else here are some newish tutorials.

== [https://lojban.io lojban.io] ==

a free opensource platform for studying Lojban with the aid of interactive exercises.

== [https://lojban.pw/books/learn-lojban/ 'Learn Lojban'] course ==

A course teaching Lojban from its formal foundations but in simple words and lots of usage examples. 

== [http://foldr.moe/hajiloji My First Lojban] ==

Learn the foundations of Lojban grammar by reading the light-hearted conversations between three girls.

== [http://www.memrise.com/course/928703/simple-lojban-in-phrases/ Simple Lojban in phrases] ==

A flashcard course on memrise.com

==[[la karda|Lojban cards]]==

A distilled overview of the language by [[User:Cadguha|ldlework]], explaining much of the grammar succinctly using examples and diagrams.

==[[Lojban Wave Lessons]]==
A fairly complete textbook initially based on the format of the live lessons given in the [[Lojban IRC]] chat. Initially written by [[User:Klaku|la klaku]] and [[User:Kribacr|la .kribacr.]] and updated over the years by many others.

==Introduction to Lojban==

[https://drive.google.com/open?id=0Bxngu1CNj7wdfnh2eXU2TTFJZi1TeDV1cVlqbjl6TWxYbXgwbldRRzRoaFF5ay1oOFlWYVk Lojban in simple phrases]. This course is already available for several languages.
Features:
*a slick format
*short introduction into Lojban
Your feedback and suggestions can make the course more comprehensive.

You may translate and adapt this course to your native language if it's not already there.

== [https://daeldir.github.io/jbogidva/ Lojban guide] ==

Provides hover translations of both sentences/phrases and words they contain.
